svg.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Chalkboard SE, sans-serif

text.tspan: Example app only (free alternative to R / MATLAB / Statistica). D3SCOPE builds the charts + building blocks; the stats plugin and the app are NOT D3SCOPE.
Three layout directions. Colours show who provides each piece. Fake sample data (iris-like).
Core plugin (official): generic utilities, e.g. brush
Stats plugin: domain charts - OUT of D3SCOPE scope
The app itself - NOT D3SCOPE (tables, panels, console)
scatter(iris, x = petal_len, y = petal_wid, facet = species)
Faceted scatter: 3 small multiples sharing scales [core]
Menu: Statistics > Basic | Regression | ANOVA | Multivariate
Building blocks a stats plugin needs from D3SCOPE core: linear/log/band scales, axes with fine tick control, legends
(incl. continuous colour legend), facet grid / small multiples with shared scales, primitives (points, line, area band
between y0 and y1, binned rects, reference lines, annotations), zoom/pan, linked selection across charts, brush (core
plugin), number formatting (significant digits, scientific notation, fr-FR), high-DPI PNG + SVG export, large-N rendering.
